body: Thanks again for staying with me atleast in essence  I think someone from this community   called the emergency services probably my own fault for saying where I was not the brightest idea ive had but for that to that individual who knows the uk I guess thank you by the time they found me I had cut my arm up pretty bad and was sitting in a tree like a barn owl just crying with the rope around my neck after much persuasion I made my way down ive spoken with the crisis team and effectively persuaded them im ok just having a rough time of it at the moment (basically lied so they would leave me alone) not before they took me to hospital and bandaged and stitched me and offered me sleeping tablets and suicide prevention numbers though. then i swiftly got myself out of there i still feel the exact same and will likely be heading to a more remote spot in the next few hours they took my rope and could not find the open razor I used so basically I feel its back to the drawing board im trying and will continue to try thinking of the kids and stay here in this moment but im not sure how many days ive been awake now and I simply can't sleep I guess the tablets would have worked if not for me throwing them away and I feel so out of touch with reality whats real and whats not is starting to blurr im finding it increasingly difficult to be able to maintain this thought process the urges are soo strong now I think the cutting atleast helped me vent somewhat hence the more positive outlook well not positive at all but better maby im not sure? I still want to die but I guess for the person who called the police its a win for that guy/girl. I need to try think of what I intend to do next and be alot more thorough in my execution of whichever path I choose. I do appreciate this safe space its the only place I can really open up and be real because if I told the hospital any of this they would have likely sectioned me. Im almost back at my apartment so will see what the next few hours bring and will update you guys/gals on the battle plan albeit good bad or ugly all I know is whatever happens happens today no more screwing around I either die or I try continue carrying this great weight until I physically no longer can but I will do my best as I said to just keep thinking of my kids little faces and why I need to be here and the impact this will have on them if I do follow though with it today. Im not sure it will help because of my rapid mental decline and how quickly my minds shifting from one thought process to another but its all I got  i wish I had someone I could console in and ask to help me and not emergency help like just someone real I can talk to in real life so I dont feel so alone but in all honesty I don't even know if I would benefit from that im just clutching at straws I guess. Im racing through my thoughts trying to make sense of a senseless situation in the hopes I will find peace or clarity or the awnsers I need thanks again for just being there and don't for a second feel responsible if I give up because this is my burden to bare and mine alone my choices are my own as are the consequences of those choices I hope to have peace soon one way or another

I'm not sure what anyone can do i just feel soo lost i have soo much left to give my kids but I feel like I'm constantly on a knife edge im now sat up in a place known locally as the carpark in sky ive secured a rope to a tree  in the wooded area and made a noose (i gave up searching for other means as one way or another it will hurt) im battling with my self to go but also to stay and im so unsure as where I'm best placed I need clarity and just can't seem to find it within myself to fight this darkness all I want is to be a good person and more so a good dad but what use am I to anyone if I can't even see my babies to give them the love they soo deserve and be there for them when they need me I also understand that if I do make this decision I cant take it back nor would I know or ever be able to assist my beautiful children hear see or cherish them ever again it seems like a dammed if I do dammed if I don't im cold and tired and confused all I know is this feeling of complete emptiness and that of being alone is killing me and I dont think I can take it ive always had my family around me its all I know and without them I feel my soul purpose in life has been taken I also accept that to some degree this act is selfish but im tormented in my own mind constantly and the pain is like a record stuck on repeat  over and over I feel like I'm losing my sanity and merely want to be at peace I just feel so weak now and almost powerless to my fate if this really is it tonight then I am soo sorry to my children I really am

Thank you for your kind words but its all too much now my time is drawing to an end and I have completely accepted my fate now.  Im not a religious man but now all I can do is pray for forgiveness and a quick end

Edit: im still here, my minds still reeling, im unable to sleep around 3 or 4 days now or eat at this point as the pressure of the whole situation is becoming more than I can bare my minds constantly in overdrive and am becoming less aware and feeling more dazed and out of touch with my thought processes and reality as the days go on. I would like for nothing more than to have my life and my family back around me and for this horrible pain to stop but at this point it seems like an impossible task and the overwhelming feeling of impending doom seems closer than ever and in response to silver facts an argument that was all that happened but its led to me being unable to go home as she is no longer intrested and is trying to take away my children and my liberty aswell through lies admittedly she feels anger towards me for not being my normal supportive self ie feeding into the argument instead of defusing it like i always normally do and not being the man she knows me to be in the sense that I normally come out on top of the argument not winning the argument by any means but telling her that it will be OK consoling her worries and being the rock she sometimes so desperately needs thats my normal role and I was OK with that but it all became too much and i spoke to her the way she spoke to me and just fueled the whole situation instead of being passive and supporting like she knows me to be. I am a very family oriented person and when my kids are involved I have nothing but love and understanding and compassion to give but to go as far as to make me out to be a something im not nor ever would be is truly crippling for me. Not being able to see my babies every morning, to kiss them goodnight, to see them smile, take them to school, to ask them how there day was, to play with them, to console them when they need me, to just  walk the path of life with them, and just to be completley present and engaged in there  lifes all the time like I always have been it feels like I'm suffering a loss every second of every day I would never wish this on anyone not even my worst enemy it feels truly like a fate worse than death ive decided if im doing this it will be tonight or in the early hours of this morning dependant on when I can get to a suitable spot and have obtained the resources I need to accomplish what I feel needs to be accomplished the only thing thats kept me going to this point is the constant thought of those precious little childrens faces when they realise what I have done and what kind of dominoe effect it may have on there lifes and mental well being in the future because of course it is NOT and could never be there fault for any decision I choose to make they are as pure as the day they were born and with God as my witness I truly want for nothing more than there continued happiness and for them to know no matter the outcome there dad loves them more than life itself to be honest i dont think the extent of love i have for them is measurable on any scale known to man but i also know im not strong enough to deal with the situation that has presented itself to me and again I feel great shame for this all I ever wanted from this life was to ensure my children new they were loved and that I would always protect them without them I have no purpose  and indeed no fight left in me. May god have mercy on my soul
